metricLabel: AWS Cloud Waste Eliminated (-68% Run Cost)

narrativeSteps.title: Client Friction
narrativeSteps.description: Enterprise healthcare SaaS was burning $3,500/mo on idle EC2 clusters with 2.4s global API latency and unoptimized database reads.

narrativeSteps.title: Architectural Action
narrativeSteps.description: Re-engineered infrastructure into zero-idle AWS Serverless Lambda, API Gateway HTTP APIs, and DynamoDB single-table design.

narrativeSteps.title: Zero-Downtime Migration
narrativeSteps.description: Executed canary deployments and 2048-bit DKIM transactional pipeline with 100% data integrity and zero customer interruption.

narrativeSteps.title: Verified Outcome
narrativeSteps.description: AWS infrastructure spend dropped 68% immediately, saving $42,000 annually while API latency plummeted to 280ms globally.

narrativeSteps.title: Client Friction

narrativeSteps.title: Voice AI Telephony

narrativeSteps.title: Autonomous Dispatch

narrativeSteps.title: Verified Outcome
